_note: Millennium Lab: one bot per department. Each department always has one job open in research_queue.json; when it finishes, lab.py queues the next one (every 30 min via ai_watchdog.py). max_open caps how many lab jobs sit in the shared agent queue at once (lower it if other projects starve).

departments.name: Murmuration Desk
departments.role: Elliptic-curve statistics: local densities, trace formula, Sawin-Sutherland comparison
departments.brief: Continue the BSD thread. Read bsd_project/FINDINGS.md and roadmap.json BSD first. Next open items: derive a_c and c_c as explicit local densities (q-adic Hurwitz averages); compare the measured a2-weighted scale with Sawin-Sutherland arXiv:2504.12295; extend checks to new conductor ranges. Add the dated result line to bsd_project/FINDINGS.md under '## Automated runs'.

departments.name: Zeta Desk
departments.role: Zero statistics: finite-height corrections, BBLM amplitude, k-fit
departments.brief: Continue the RH thread. Read rh_project/FINDINGS.md and roadmap.json RH first. Next open items: compare the 9-height BBLM amplitudes with the Bogomolny et al. 2006 second-order term; widen the exploratory k ~ 1.1 fit; test other statistics (number variance, nearest-neighbour tails) on the stored zeros. Add the dated result line to rh_project/FINDINGS.md under '## Automated runs'.

departments.name: Erdos Bench
departments.role: One open Erdos prize problem per job: literature + forum check, computation, honest status
departments.brief: Work the Erdos prize problem named below. Read its erdosproblems.com page, comments and cited papers first (many have recent partial results). Write prize_work/<id>.md: exact statement, prize, what is known (with references), and one computation you ran (script in prize_work/<id>/ with a gate reproducing a known value, e.g. a published small case). If you find something that looks new, set status needs_review with one line why; never post on the forum or claim a prize.

departments.name: Bounty Hunters
departments.role: Searches, records and counterexamples for the catalogue's computable bounties
departments.brief: Work the prize problem named below. Read the source page first. Write prize_work/<id>.md (statement, prize terms, best known record, why it is hard, feasibility for a laptop) and run one bounded search or experiment yourself (script in prize_work/<id>/, at most 1 h CPU, with a gate). Report the exact range searched. Never submit anything to a sponsor.

departments.name: Packing Shop
departments.role: Solver for packing n unit squares (n = 1..1000) into the smallest square; tracks the score
departments.brief: Improve the Squares in Squares solver in prize_work/squares-in-squares/ (create it on the first job). Score = sum over n=1..1000 of (L/sqrt(n) - 1), lower is better. Keep a strict validity checker (no overlaps, inside the container; exact or epsilon-safe geometry) as the gate. After every job write prize_work/squares-in-squares/best_score.json as {"score": float, "valid": true, "baseline": float, "n_improved": int, "updated": ISO time} and keep submission.csv for the best valid packing. Start from known constructions (Friedman's packing-squares page) before local search. Juwen uploads to Kaggle himself.

departments.name: Library
departments.problem: Navier-Stokes, Yang-Mills, P vs NP, Hodge
departments.role: Reads the week's new papers on the four problems the lab does not compute on
departments.brief: Read the newest digest in automation/digests/ and pick the 3 most substantial new papers on Navier-Stokes, Yang-Mills, P vs NP or Hodge. For each write a 6-10 line brief in scout_notes/<date>.md: claim, method, status (preprint / peer reviewed / known to have gaps), and whether anything is checkable by computation here. Flag crank or unrefereed 'proofs' as such.

departments.name: Referee
departments.role: Re-runs the gates of finished jobs, downgrades overclaims
departments.brief: Review the finished lab jobs listed below. For each: re-run its script/gate, check the numbers in the result match the files, check the wording claims nothing beyond the evidence (no 'proof', no 'solved'). Write review_notes/<job id>.md (pass / fix / fail + one line), set the reviewed job's 'reviewed' field to pass|fix|fail, and fix wording in FINDINGS.md if needed.

departments.name: Press Room
departments.role: Turns reviewed results into the first-month package: BSD note, RH note, prize dossier index
departments.brief: Advance the first-month package (milestone M3): bsd_project/paper/bsd_note.md (F10/F11 + a2-weighted murmurations, honest limits, reproducible scripts listed), rh_project/paper/rh_note.md (finite-height BBLM corrections), prize_work/INDEX.md (one line per dossier). Only reviewed results go in. Drafts only: never email or publish.
